The Plaza Mural Vote

Click  🎧  to listen.
Listen to a teacher talking to his students about how to evaluate an argument in the news. Listen carefully. You will hear the information only once. After listening, you will answer four questions. As you listen, you may use the blank areas in your Test Book to take notes.
Listen to the Presentation
1 QUESTION 1:
What is the teacher mainly explaining?
2 QUESTION 2:
According to the teacher, what was the reporter's claim?
3 QUESTION 3:
Why does the teacher say the interview with the three longtime residents was relevant evidence?
4 QUESTION 4:
Why does the teacher compare the interview to the study from a different city?
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
Answer all 4 questions to submit.
